criterion: ROADMAP.md M3 criterion 1 (amended 2026-10-10), first step: the CPU ray-traced AO reference moves from a scan of every triangle to the BVH, with a guard, so that raw-hero and raw-hall can be rendered verified. Approved by the coordinator on 2026-10-17: move the reference onto a BVH; before the identity golden changes, show on small scenes the brute-force reference finishes on that the BVH reference matches it within bounds committed first; keep the brute force as a test-only oracle.
written: 2026-10-17, before any code and before any run
design: LinearAccel keeps building its triangle list in the arena exactly as today, so the arena certificate's allocation record is unchanged. It also builds a raw::Bvh (raw/renderer/bvh.hpp) from that list on the heap, and occluded() asks the BVH. The BVH's triangle test is the same intersectTri with the same t < maxDist rule, so an occlusion query is predicted to return what the scan returns; only its box test can differ, on rays that graze a box face. The scan stays as LinearAccel::occludedScan, used by the oracle runs: RAW_NATIVE_AO_ORACLE=scan makes occluded() scan (test-only; the CLI never sets it). The GPU rtao pass is not changed in this step.

g1_unit.what: tests/test_ao_bvh.cpp: computeRTAO with the BVH against the scan on small scenes the scan finishes on: the built-in test scene at 128 x 128 with 64 samples; a 3 x 3 grid of the M3 gallery's spheres; raw-hero at 64 x 40 with 16 samples
g1_unit.bound: per-pixel AO bit-identical on at least 99.99% of covered pixels and no pixel more than one sample (1/samples) apart
g1_unit.prediction: bit-identical on every pixel of every scene

g2_golden.what: the CPU outputs of the identity matrix (scripts/identity_matrix.py run, no GPU) and the ten glTF models against the committed goldens evidence/identity-golden.json and evidence/m2-gltf-golden.json, every file including arena_certificate.json
g2_golden.bound: byte-identical: the golden does not change
g2_golden.prediction: byte-identical. If any file differs, the golden is not updated in this step; the difference is recorded and explained first

g3_oracle.what: the same identity matrix and glTF runs with RAW_NATIVE_AO_ORACLE=scan against the BVH runs

g4_control.what: false-success control: RAW_NATIVE_AO_ORACLE=skew (test-only) shortens the BVH query distance by 1%
g4_control.bound: the unit guard fails on at least one scene and the golden compare differs

g5_cost.what: CPU time of computeRTAO on raw-hero at 64 x 40, BVH against scan, in the unit test (one run each, recorded, not judged)
g5_cost.prediction: the BVH is at least 100 times faster

not_in_this_step: The GPU rtao and raster passes (each a scan of every triangle per pixel) and the verified renders of raw-hero and raw-hall; the path-traced error per scene. Those follow with their own bounds.
does_not_prove: That the AO estimate is right (it is a 64-sample estimate either way); anything about the GPU paths.
